items.title: De'Anthony Melton's contract with the Warriors came in higher than was reported. Melton got the full Taxpayer MLE:
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
De'Anthony Melton's contract with the Warriors came in higher than was reported. Melton got the full Taxpayer MLE:

2026-27: $6.064M
2027-28: $6.4M

2027-28 is a player option for Melton. GSW is hard-capped at the second apron by using the Tax MLE. GSW has ~$5.2M in room under the second apron.

items.title: Moe Wagner's contract with the Brooklyn Nets came in a little lower than was reported:
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Moe Wagner's contract with the Brooklyn Nets came in a little lower than was reported:

2026-27: $9M
2027-28: $9.45M

2027-28 is a mutual option, as was reported. Either Wagner or the Nets can opt in for 2027-28.

Brooklyn has roughly $4.9M remaining in cap space for this season.
